notes: Two distinct Table 3 sections are present: one for Chick-fil-A Licensed Units and one for Chick-fil-A Franchised Restaurants. Both are captured in state_year_status. Licensed Unit rows appear first (states AL through WY plus TOTAL rollup), followed by Franchised Restaurant rows (states AL through WY plus TOTAL rollup). State rows in the Licensed Units section do not include IA, HI, ME, NH, OR, RI, WA, or WI as those states have zero licensed units. The Franchised Restaurants 2024 RI row shows outlets_start=2 though the prior year end was 1 — this matches the source document exactly and may reflect an OCR or typesetting artifact in the original; captured as-is. The yearly_summary section contains both Licensed Unit rows (labeled 'franchised'/'company-owned'/'total') and Franchised+Company-Operated Restaurant rows; the Licensed Unit rows use 'franchised' for the 'Licensed' outlet type since that is the closest schema match.
